name: Job Market Analytics Portal
description: A searchable job market workspace with skills, salary trends, saved searches, and application tracking.
summary: An interconnected view of job listings, in-demand skills, salaries, and market trends. Saved searches and application tracking extend the analytics into a personal job-search workflow.
architecture: Flask routes render HTML templates and expose job-market workflows. Flask-SQLAlchemy accesses PostgreSQL records. JavaScript and Chart.js present interactive dashboards styled with Tailwind CSS.

capabilities.name: Job exploration
capabilities.description: Search and filter job listings and inspect individual roles.

capabilities.name: Market insights
capabilities.description: Explore in-demand skills, salaries, and market trends.

capabilities.name: Search and application tracking
capabilities.description: Save searches and manage job applications.

stack.usage: Flask serves dashboards, job details, saved searches, and application routes.
Python queries and aggregates job records for skill and trend analysis.
Flask-SQLAlchemy maps and queries persisted job and application records.
PostgreSQL stores seeded listings and application workspace data.
JavaScript connects filters and interactive chart presentation in rendered pages.
Chart.js visualizes salary and skill analytics within dashboard pages.
Tailwind utilities style responsive templates and controls.

architectureConnections.description: Portal routes query job and application models.
ORM queries read and update relational records.
Browser interactions render market statistics as charts.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
